scope: Explicit spoken needs in the browser and board recommendation entry, native authenticated API, durable confirmation recovery and bounded response guards. No physical device or live speech test.

covered: explicit need versus exact group-name command
first current final result only; cleanup before recommendation
late permission/transcription/model results, hidden page, audio-off and identity ownership invalidation
native TLS-context/Host/Origin/fetch-site/auth gates with the real HTTP handler and synthetic model
lost confirmation reply and service restart preserve the original operation and recommendation binding
retained local workers and unconfirmed known remote cleanup block recommendation
capability unavailable creates no RTA session or recommendation POST
before-POST and in-flight cancellation, accepted confirmation during failing/changing/expiring state refresh
same-current-group confirmation still consumes the recommendation through its original endpoint
format-1 NVS read compatibility and format-2 full payload conflict/terminal matching with transactional NVS doubles
raw and decoded NUL, invalid UTF-8, duplicate escaped binding keys, conflicting terminal epoch and bounded response tree
legal maximum three-card response and 128-group state remain accepted
real LVGL 800x480 layout and pointer hit tests; scrolling versus selection; separate confirmation; expiry/revision guards; both old keyboard positioning mutations rejected

pending_acceptance: real browser speech and user gesture/microphone permissions
physical board touch, ASR final result and recommendation review
real model semantic quality across a labeled need set
confirmed target-group media recovery, PTT and listening with this candidate
physical NVS/power-loss and sustained memory/recovery behavior
interpretation: Host doubles validate software boundaries and fault handling. Target compilation and static memory size do not prove hardware reliability, ASR accuracy, model recommendation quality or real media recovery. Older listening evidence is not reused as this candidate acceptance.
